How We Build

Our Construction Process

Engineered step-by-step from blueprint design to rapid on-site assembly across Nepal.

← Swipe process steps →

01

Architectural Design & Customization

Our engineers work with client blueprints to design seismic-certified steel framing and precise panel layouts.

02

Precision Factory Manufacturing

High-density EPS and PUF sandwich panels are manufactured under strict Korean quality control standards.

03

Rapid On-Site Frame & Panel Assembly

Pre-engineered components are transported to site and assembled within days using direct-screw steel fasteners.

04

Quality Inspection & Handover

Thorough thermal, sound, and weather-seal testing conducted prior to final keys handover.
